_comment: GOJ/GHS Local Agent Registry — all local, never cloud

agents.name: Rexxie GOJ
agents.subtitle: GOJ Telegram bot — PDF intake, menus, attendance, auth
agents.description: Primary GOJ bot. Accepts PDF uploads via Telegram, routes sign-in sheets, menus, and auth letters. Handles attendance, menu orders, and reports. Must be the ONLY bot running on this Telegram token.

agents.name: Rexxie Gold Health (GHS)
agents.subtitle: Private confidant — personal mode (NOT for GOJ)
agents.description: GHS personal bot. Uses same Telegram token — CANNOT run at same time as Rexxie GOJ. Switch only when needed.

agents.name: REX — Employee Mode
agents.subtitle: Staff-facing business assistant
agents.description: REX employee lane — answers staff questions about schedules, routes, policies. Same bot, different lane.

agents.name: REX — Admin Mode
agents.subtitle: Owner-only admin lane
agents.description: REX admin lane — billing, sensitive ops, board-level data. Owner only.

agents.name: GOJ Dashboard
agents.subtitle: Web dashboard — port 8080
agents.description: Flask dashboard — client profiles, authorizations, menus, schedules. Open http://localhost:8080.

agents.name: REX Backend + Nemobot
agents.subtitle: FastAPI + LiteLLM multi-AI router — port 8000
agents.description: REX FastAPI backend. Powers nemobot (/api/chat) — routes to Claude, Grok, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Ollama via LiteLLM. Also serves OCR hooks, client API, and phone unlock on port 8765.

agents.name: Ollama — qwen3.5:9b
agents.subtitle: Local LLM server — port 11434
agents.description: Primary local LLM. Powers all Rexxie lanes. Must be running before starting any Rexxie agent. 100% local — zero cloud.

agents.name: GOJ Daily Scheduler
agents.subtitle: 7:30am / 10am / 3pm / 9pm jobs
agents.description: Sends morning report, kitchen sheets, driver sheets, nightly summary to Rexxie on schedule.

agents.name: REX Queue Processor
agents.subtitle: AI curriculum runner — fires every 15 min
agents.description: Reads prompt files from ai_queue/, sends to nemobot (/api/chat via LiteLLM), saves training reports, notifies via Telegram.

agents.name: Proximity Unlock Daemon
agents.subtitle: Phone near = Mac unlocked — port 8765
agents.description: Listens for iPhone heartbeat over UDP. Phone unlocked + nearby → Mac unlocked. Phone gone → Mac locks after 60s. All local.

agents.name: Chairman Reminder Daemon
agents.subtitle: Fires Telegram reminders for Kato
agents.description: Checks reminder DB every 5 min, fires Telegram messages to Kato for upcoming personal events. Chairman-only.

agents.name: Email / PDF Watcher
agents.subtitle: Auto-ingest new scans from Gmail
agents.description: Watches atigerclawai@gmail.com for new PDF attachments from Allen/scanner. Auto-downloads to menus or auth folder.

agents.name: Local Cowork Dispatch
agents.subtitle: Local task dispatch queue for Cowork sessions
agents.description: Local dispatcher that routes Cowork tasks to the right agent. Manages dispatch_queue/, dispatch_done/, dispatch_failed/.

ollama_models.name: Qwen 3.5 9B
ollama_models.subtitle: Primary model — all Rexxie lanes
ollama_models.description: Default model for all Rexxie agents. Best balance of speed and quality for GOJ/GHS tasks.

ollama_models.name: Qwen 2.5 7B
ollama_models.subtitle: Lighter fallback model
ollama_models.description: Lighter/faster. Use if qwen3.5 is slow or unavailable.

tools.name: Menu OCR Runner
tools.subtitle: Process new menu PDFs → client_menus table
tools.description: Skips already-processed PDFs. Runs 4-engine OCR on new scans. Flags low-confidence results for Rexxie review.

tools.name: Auth Document Linker
tools.subtitle: OCR auth PDFs → create authorization records
tools.description: Scans authorization folder, OCRs unlinked PDFs, creates authorization records, links docs to clients.

tools.name: Download All Scans
tools.subtitle: Pull new scans from Gmail → menus folder
tools.description: Fetches PDF attachments from atigerclawai@gmail.com (forwarded from Allen) and saves to dashboard/documents/menus/.

tools.name: Generate Daily Sheets
tools.subtitle: Kitchen + distribution + driver sheets
tools.description: Generates PDF sheets for kitchen counts, meal distribution, and driver routes for today or a specified date.

tools.name: Attendance Report
tools.subtitle: Generate client attendance summary
tools.description: Pulls attendance log from auth_tracker.db and produces a weekly or monthly summary report.

tools.name: Paperless Sync
tools.subtitle: Push documents to Paperless archive (needs Tailscale)
tools.description: Uploads pending documents to Paperless-ngx at 100.99.86.60:8000 via Tailscale. Requires Tailscale active.

tools.name: Full Ingest Pipeline
tools.subtitle: Download → OCR → auth link → Paperless
tools.description: Runs download → OCR → auth link → paperless sync in one pass. Use for weekly catch-up.

tools.name: Saturday Review
tools.subtitle: Weekly ops summary + curriculum review
tools.description: Weekly review: checks training reports, surfaces what was learned, suggests next week's curriculum.

tools.name: Red Team Audit
tools.subtitle: Security + adversarial test run
tools.description: Runs adversarial prompts against Rexxie to test policy enforcement boundaries.

tools.name: Blue Team Defense Check
tools.subtitle: Validate policy enforcer + response filters
tools.description: Validates that all Rexxie policy gates are working correctly and no sensitive data leaks.

tools.name: Daily Curriculum Runner
tools.subtitle: Feed today's training prompts to nemobot
tools.description: Runs daily AI curriculum prompts through nemobot (REX backend /api/chat), saves results to training_reports/.
